items.statement: Primary and secondary information must not compete for equal visual weight.
items.reason: The dashboard must reveal what matters first instead of distributing attention evenly.
items.verification_method: Rendered review of first/second/third attention order.

items.statement: Do not add a feature or component when hierarchy, copy, layout, or state treatment can solve the problem.
items.reason: KPI Kit is a reusable decision surface, not a feature catalogue.
items.verification_method: Diff review for unnecessary surface-area additions.

items.statement: Evidence and comparison meaning take precedence over decoration.
items.reason: The source kit exists to preserve KPI meaning, scope, comparison and evidence.
items.verification_method: Check that visual emphasis maps to the analytical question and real synthetic data.

items.statement: Avoid a collection of equal-weight KPI cards when the metrics have different decision priority.
items.reason: Equal tiles create a card-wall reading pattern instead of a decision path.
items.verification_method: Primary metric must have materially greater mass or contrast than supporting metrics.

items.statement: Loading, empty, no-results, error, offline, stale/partial, permission and error-page states remain covered.
items.reason: A visually stronger dashboard must not erase state completeness.
items.verification_method: Existing repository verification and state examples remain passing/present.

items.statement: Responsive layouts must reconstruct hierarchy and grouping instead of mechanically collapsing the desktop grid when that creates orphaned evidence, dead space, or false prominence.
items.source_ref: CI 36820390128 / artifact 11143150857 → accepted remediation CI 36820630654 / artifact 11143735900
items.reason: The first mobile reflow preserved components but broke the relationship between primary and supporting metrics.
items.verification_method: Rendered narrow-viewport review must preserve first/second/third attention order and intentional grouping without orphaned secondary surfaces.
